response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with exposure to AI-agent systems and cloud technologies, aligning well with the Staff Forward Deployed Engineer role. While his AI-specific experience is less explicit than ideal, his technical leadership, customer-facing work, and contributions to developer tooling (e.g., MCP code generators) suggest potential. Gaps in direct GenAI/RAG experience and advanced AI degrees may limit his fit for the most specialized aspects of the role.
strengths: Proven technical leadership as a Staff Software Engineer, including mentorship and cross-functional collaboration.
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling at re:cinq.
Strong full-stack development background with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms (AWS), enabling seamless integration with customer systems.
concerns: Limited explicit experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures or vector databases in production.
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in AI or related fields, which is preferred for this role.
AI/GenAI experience is primarily recent and not deeply detailed in the resume, raising questions about depth of expertise.
